title: Pre-Test Gate

phases.name: design
phases.note: Scope built interactively, section by section; preflight score 100, zero blocking issues, zero warnings.

taskGroups.name: Phase A — Stand up a truthful clone
Phase C — Reconcile test items against change
Phase D — Make the gate mandatory

sequencingConstraints: T003 before any write task — production unreachability proven before the first write
T002 before T004 — nothing to apply DDL to until the clone is certified faithful
T005 before T006 — the seed contract must exist before implement authors against it
T012 ships with T011 — a repair loop without the assertion guard is net-negative
T021 before T016 — do not make the gate blocking until proven against a real scope
openQuestions: Disposition of a clone left by an unattended red run — time-based sweep, or is --list plus next-run-drops-predecessor sufficient?
Do seeds belong on disk at tests/seeds/<NNN-name>/ or filed to the wxKanban DB alongside plans and items?
How should preTest behave for a scope with no HTTP or UI surface, where gates 1 and 2 have nothing to drive?
If pending SQL is corrected after a pre-test run, is it re-verified automatically or does that need a fresh run the operator must remember to trigger?
